entities.name: GraphRAG
entities.description: A system that generates community summaries by adding element summaries to a template, designed to scale to very large datasets.

entities.name: Community Summaries
entities.description: Report-like summaries of communities in a hierarchy, used to understand global structure and semantics or for answering global queries.

properties.mechanism: Hierarchical summarization using LLM context windows

entities.name: Global Queries
entities.description: A type of query answered using the graph-based index and community summaries.

relationships.description: GraphRAG generates community summaries as part of its process.
GraphRAG uses community summaries as part of a graph-based index for answering global queries.
